scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && CGO_ENABLED=1 CGO_CFLAGS="${CGO_CFLAGS:+$CGO_CFLAGS }-Wno-error=missing-braces" go build -tags sqlite_fts5 -o dist/wacli ./cmd/wacli
scripts.check: bun run --silent format:check && bun run --silent lint && bun run --silent lint:deadcode && bun run --silent test && bun run --silent build && bun run --silent docs:site && git diff --check
scripts.test: bun run --silent test:go && bun run --silent test:fts && bun run --silent test:windows-lock && bun run --silent test:cgo-required && bun run --silent test:docs
scripts.test:cgo-required: bash -c 'set +e; out=$(CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./cmd/wacli 2>&1); status=$?; set -e; echo "$out" | grep -q wacli_requires_cgo_enabled_1_for_go_sqlite3; test $status -ne 0'
scripts.format:check: bash -c 'out=$(gofmt -l .); if [ -n "$out" ]; then echo "$out"; exit 1; fi'
